title: P&G's Awards and Recognitions: Shaping Careers, Inclusion and Consumer Impact
summary: Discover P&G's impressive awards and recognitions, showcasing excellence in careers, equality, and business impact. Learn more about our global leadership today.
body_markdown:
When the **Human Rights Campaign (HRC) Foundation** released its **2023-2024 Corporate Equality Index, P&G received a score of 100 for the 10th year in a row** . P&G was also 1 of only 30 companies to receive triple certification, having the distinction of earning top scores on three out of five of HRC’s Corporate Equality Index measures of LBGTQ+ inclusion.


[Learn](https://us.pg.com/equality-and-inclusion/) about our efforts to create a company where equality and inclusion are achievable for all.


### Making a Positive Impact with Corporate Citizenship


Whether we’re providing laundry services to those impacted by natural disasters through our[Tide Loads of Hope](https://tide.com/en-us/our-commitment/loads-of-hope) program or ensuring children around the world have[safe drinking water](https://csdw.org/) , improving the everyday lives of people and helping the communities in which we live and work is core to our purpose and values.


**3BL Media** released its 2023 ranking of the[100 Best Corporate Citizens](https://100best.3blmedia.com/) where **P&G ranked fourth in the Household & Personal Products Industry** .


Our business is built on our commitment to continuing to raise the bar on all aspects of superiority while meeting and balancing the needs of all stakeholders. Our integrated growth strategy built on five focus areas — supply, environment, suitability, digital acumen and a superior employee value equation — is further strengthening our organization.


It is the capabilities, passion and commitment of P&G’s people to serve people in small but meaningful ways, everyday, that make these recognitions possible.[Learn more](https://us.pg.com/awards-and-recognition/) about P&G’s other recent honors and our efforts to inspire positive impact inside and outside our company.
